It is built with\nPython 3.14.6 and the standard library only (`http.server`, `sqlite3`, `json`,\netc.).\n\n## How to start and verify the server\n\n```bash\n# Run in the foreground on the port specified by PORT (default 8080).\n./run.sh\n\n# In another terminal, verify the health endpoint:\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# -> {\"ok\": true}\n```\n\n`run.sh` executes `uv run --python 3.14.6 python server.py`. The server listens\non `127.0.0.1` and binds to the `PORT` environment variable.\n\n## Entry point and major modules\n\n| File | Responsibility |\n|------|------------------|\n| `server.py` | Entry point. Imports `Handler` from `api` and starts `http.server.HTTPServer`. |\n| `api.py` | HTTP request/response helpers, route tables, the `Handler` class, and endpoint handlers. |\n| `storage.py` | SQLite persistence layer. Defines the `Storage` class and the module-level `storage` singleton. |\n| `domain.py` | Pure, deterministic game-rule and authentication computations. |\n| `constants.py` | Literal game tables, valid choice sets, and compiled route patterns. |\n| `run.sh` | Launcher script required by the evaluation harness. |\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state is stored in a single SQLite file named `game.db` in the\ncurrent working directory. The `storage` singleton in `storage.py` initializes\nthe schema on import, so the database is created as soon as the server starts.\n\nTables (declared in `Storage._TABLES` in dependency order):\n\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashes and salts.\n- `sessions` — combat initiative order, round/turn index, and active conditions.\n- `compendium_monsters` and `compendium_items` — reusable reference entries.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events` — classic campaign state and log.\n- `campaign_quests`, `campaign_factions`, `campaign_npcs` — quest and relationship tracking.\n- `campaign_inventory`, `crafting_projects` — shared inventory and downtime crafting.\n- `campaign_sessions`, `session_attendance` — session scheduling and attendance.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members` — live-play campaign lobby, party, and character build state.\n- `narrations` — chronological narration, action, travel, rest, scene, and resolution events.\n- `campaign_documents` — durable story text and DM-only notes.\n- `scenes` — named scenes within a play campaign, each `open` or `closed`.\n- `campaign_locations`, `location_connections` — location graph for travel turns.\n- `encounters` — active/closed combat encounters with combatants, conditions, and rewards.\n\n`POST /v1/storage/reset` drops and recreates all tables except `users`, keeping\nregistered actors available across the maintenance reset performed by the\ncumulative evaluator suite. `GET /v1/storage/status` reports the driver, schema\nversion, and initialization flag.\n\n### Request routing\n\n`api.py` keeps four ordered lists of route tuples `(compiled_pattern, handler)`:\n`GET_ROUTES`, `POST_ROUTES`, `PUT_ROUTES`, and `DELETE_ROUTES`. The first match\nwins, preserving the dispatch order of the original implementation, which\nmatters where a more specific regex could otherwise shadow a shorter exact path.\n\n`Handler` delegates each HTTP method to `_dispatch`, which iterates the\nappropriate route table, passes the `re.Match` object (and parsed JSON body for\nmutating methods) to the matched handler, and falls back to\n`{\"error\": \"not found\"}` with HTTP 404.\n\nDynamic segments (e.g., `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}`) are captured by the\nregex and passed to the handler as a `re.Match` object.\n\n### Response contract\n\nAll JSON responses are sent via `send_json`, which sets `Content-Type` and\n`Content-Length`. Error payloads are intentionally coarse-grained (e.g.\n`{\"error\": \"invalid request\"}`) and match the original behavior.\n\n### Authentication and access control\n\n- `_authenticate` validates the `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`\n  header and returns the actor along with an error code (401 for missing/\n  malformed tokens, 403 for unknown users or role mismatches).\n- `_require_auth` sends the appropriate JSON response and returns `None` on\n  failure.\n- `_load_play_campaign` fetches a live campaign and enforces access: with\n  `require_owner=True` the actor must own the campaign; otherwise the actor must\n  be either the owner or a party member.\n- `_load_encounter` fetches an encounter within a campaign and sends the standard\n  404 response when it is missing.\n- `_require_encounter_owner` combines owner-only campaign access with encounter\n  existence for DM-only encounter mutations.\n\nThe legacy `authenticate`, `authenticate_player`, and `authenticate_actor`\nfunctions remain as thin wrappers for compatibility.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n### Core helpers (`/v1/dice/*`, `/v1/checks/*`, `/v1/encounters/*`, `/v1/initiative/*`)\n\n- Dice expression parsing (`2d6+3`, `1d20-1`) and min/max/average stats.\n- Ability checks with margin calculation.\n- Encounter adjusted XP and difficulty using the DMG multiplier table.\n- Deterministic initiative ordering: score descending, then dexterity descending,\n  then name ascending.\n\n### Character helpers (`/v1/characters/*`)\n\n- Ability score modifier (floors negative halves).\n- Proficiency bonus by level.\n- Derived stats: modifiers, AC (base + capped DEX + shield), and max HP.\n  The derived-stats endpoint uses a simplified HP formula; class-based progression\n  lives in `domain.max_hp_for_level` and is used by the play-campaign build path.\n\n### Combat (`/v1/combat/sessions/*`)\n\n- Create a session from a list of combatants; the system sorts them and stores\n  the order.\n- Add conditions to a combatant with a remaining-rounds duration.\n- Advance the turn; when the turn wraps, the round increments and the active\n  combatant's conditions have their remaining duration decremented.\n\n### Auth (`/v1/auth/*`)\n\n- Register with username validation, password length, and role (`dm` / `player`).\n- Login with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 verification and a deterministic session token.\n\n### Compendium (`/v1/compendium/*`)\n\n- Create and read monsters and items by slug.\n\n### Classic campaigns (`/v1/campaigns/*`)\n\n- Create a campaign, add characters, append events, and read the aggregate\n  campaign state (`characters` + `log_count`).\n- Manage quests, factions, NPCs, inventory, equipment, crafting, and sessions.\n- Audit, export, and analytics endpoints report aggregate counts.\n\n### PHB rules (`/v1/phb/*`)\n\n- Wizard level 5 spell slots.\n- Long rest restoration (HP, hit dice, exhaustion).\n- Carrying capacity and encumbrance.\n\n### DM tools (`/v1/dm/*`)\n\n- Encounter builder that looks up monsters and returns adjusted XP + difficulty\n  recommendation.\n- Hardcoded tier-1 loot parcel and deterministic session recap helpers.\n\n### Play campaigns (`/v1/play/campaigns/*`)\n\n- DM-owned live campaigns with a `lobby` -> `active` lifecycle.\n- Players join with a character; the DM starts the campaign once at least two\n  players have joined.\n- Deterministic player/DM round-robin turn queue.\n- DM narrations, player actions, travel/rest turns, and DM resolutions advance\n  the event log and turn queue.\n- Turn nudges track how many times the DM has prompted the current actor.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document` returns the public story for players and\n  both story and `dm_notes` for the DM. `PUT /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document`\n  updates it (DM only).\n\n### Scenes, locations, and encounters (`/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/...`)\n\n- Scenes: DM creates, enters, and closes named scenes. `GET .../scenes/current`\n  returns the current open scene for all authorized actors.\n- Locations: DM creates locations and directed connections with travel-turn\n  costs. Authorized actors can list reachable destinations from a location.\n- Encounters: DM creates encounters, adds/removes monster combatants, and\n  binds/unbinds party members. Party members act on their initiative turn.\n- Damage/healing applies to encounter combatants and updates monster state or\n  the bound party member's persistent HP.\n- Conditions apply to a combatant by `monster_id` or member username and expire\n  at the start of that combatant's next active turn.\n- Delay and ready actions allow a player to reposition in initiative or declare\n  a triggered action.\n- Rewards (XP and loot) are recorded once per encounter; closing and ending an\n  encounter transitions back to exploration.\n\n### Play-campaign characters (`/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/characters/{cid}/...`)\n\n- Ownership can be claimed by a party member and transferred to another party\n  member.\n- The owner builds the character with race, class, background, and ability scores,\n  producing level-1 HP, hit dice, and proficiency bonus.\n- Level-up advances by exactly one level at a time using `domain.max_hp_for_level`.\n- Skill checks combine an ability score, proficiency bonus, and a declared\n  proficiency.\n- Damage, death saves, and status endpoints track durable HP and death-save\n  state.\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. Define the route pattern in `constants.py` if it has dynamic segments, or use\n   a literal `re.compile(r\"^/v1/...$\")` in `api.py`.\n2. Use the\n  `_connection()` context manager to ensure every connection is closed. ORDER BY id\",\n                (campaign_id, settlement_id),\n            ).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\n                \"shop_id\": r[0],\n                \"name\": r[1],\n                \"stock\": json.loads(r[2]),\n                \"buy_price\": r[3],\n                \"sell_price\": r[4],\n            }\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def buy_from_shop(self, campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id, character_id, item_id, quantity):\n        \"\"\"Atomically buy items from a shop.\n\n        Returns (shop_response, character_gold, remaining_stock) on success,\n        False when stock is insufficient, or None when a required row is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            shop_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT stock_json, buy_price FROM campaign_shops WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if shop_row is None:\n                return None\n            stock = json.loads(shop_row[0])\n            buy_price = shop_row[1]\n            if item_id not in stock or stock[item_id] < quantity:\n                return False\n            gold_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if gold_row is None:\n                return None\n            gold = gold_row[0]\n            total_cost = buy_price * quantity\n            if gold < total_cost:\n                return False\n            stock[item_id] -= quantity\n            if stock[item_id] == 0:\n                del stock[item_id]\n            new_gold = gold - total_cost\n            inv_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT quantity FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if inv_row is None:\n                new_inv = quantity\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, new_inv),\n                )\n            else:\n                new_inv = inv_row[0] + quantity\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE play_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                    (new_inv, campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n                )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE campaign_shops SET stock_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(stock), campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (new_gold, campaign_id, character_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            shop = self.get_shop(campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id)\n            return (self._shop_response(shop), new_gold, shop[\"stock\"].get(item_id, 0))\n\n    def sell_to_shop(self, campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id, character_id, item_id, quantity):\n        \"\"\"Atomically sell items to a shop.\n\n        Returns (shop_response, character_gold, new_stock) on success,\n        False when character inventory is insufficient, or None when a required\n        row is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            shop_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT stock_json, sell_price FROM campaign_shops WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if shop_row is None:\n                return None\n            stock = json.loads(shop_row[0])\n            sell_price = shop_row[1]\n            gold_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if gold_row is None:\n                return None\n            gold = gold_row[0]\n            inv_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT quantity FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if inv_row is None or inv_row[0] < quantity:\n                return False\n            held = inv_row[0]\n            remaining = held - quantity\n            if remaining == 0:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"DELETE FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                    (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n                )\n            else:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE play_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                    (remaining, campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n                )\n            stock[item_id] = stock.get(item_id, 0) + quantity\n            new_gold = gold + sell_price * quantity\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE campaign_shops SET stock_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(stock), campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (new_gold, campaign_id, character_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            shop = self.get_shop(campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id)\n            return (self._shop_response(shop), new_gold, shop[\"stock\"][item_id])\n\n    def create_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_npcs (campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT name, agenda, public_status FROM play_campaign_npcs WHERE campaign_id = ? AND npc_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, npc_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"npc_id\": npc_id,\n            \"campaign_id\": campaign_id,\n            \"name\": row[0],\n            \"agenda\": row[1],\n            \"public_status\": row[2],\n        }\n\n    def create_play_campaign_npc_dialogue(\n        self, campaign_id, npc_id, dialogue_id, speaker, text, visibility\n    ):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_npc_dialogue \"\n                    \"(campaign_id, npc_id, dialogue_id, speaker, text, visibility) \"\n                    \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, npc_id, dialogue_id, speaker, text, visibility),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_play_campaign_npc_dialogue(self, campaign_id, npc_id):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT dialogue_id, speaker, text, visibility FROM play_campaign_npc_dialogue \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND npc_id = ? ORDER BY id\",\n                (campaign_id, npc_id),\n            ).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\n                \"dialogue_id\": r[0],\n                \"speaker\": r[1],\n                \"text\": r[2],\n                \"visibility\": r[3],\n            }\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def create_play_faction(self, campaign_id, faction_id, name):\n        \"\"\"Create a faction for a play campaign. The returned record contains the bounded total\n        ``reputation`` and the original ``delta``.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT reputation FROM play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND faction_id = ? AND character_id = ? \"\n                \"ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1\",\n                (campaign_id, faction_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            current = row[0] if row else 0\n            total = max(-100, min(100, current + delta))\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"(campaign_id, faction_id, character_id, delta, reason, reputation) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, faction_id, character_id, delta, reason, total),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        return {\n            \"faction_id\": faction_id,\n            \"character_id\": character_id,\n            \"reputation\": total,\n            \"delta\": delta,\n            \"reason\": reason,\n        }\n\n    def get_play_reputation_history(self, campaign_id, faction_id, character_id=None):\n        \"\"\"Return reputation history entries for a faction in insertion order.\n\n        If ``character_id`` is supplied, only entries for that character are\n        returned.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            sql = (\n                \"SELECT character_id, delta, reason, reputation FROM play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND faction_id = ?\"\n            )\n            params = [campaign_id, faction_id]\n            if character_id is not None:\n                sql += \" AND character_id = ?\"\n                params.append(character_id)\n            sql += \" ORDER BY id\"\n            rows = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\n                \"faction_id\": faction_id,\n                \"character_id\": r[0],\n                \"reputation\": r[3],\n                \"delta\": r[1],\n                \"reason\": r[2],\n            }\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def update_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id, agenda, public_status):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_npcs SET agenda = ?, public_status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND npc_id = ?\",\n                (agenda, public_status, campaign_id, npc_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return cursor.rowcount > 0\n\n    def is_campaign_entity(self, campaign_id, entity_id):\n        \"\"\"Return True when the id names a campaign member character or NPC.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, entity_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is not None:\n                return True\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM play_campaign_npcs WHERE campaign_id = ? AND npc_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, entity_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            return row is not None\n\n    def create_relationship(self, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score):\n        \"\"\"Insert a new directed relationship edge.\n\n        Returns the edge dict on success, None when the campaign is missing,\n        and False for a duplicate (source, target, kind) tuple.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            campaign = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\", (campaign_id,)\n            ).fetchone()\n            if campaign is None:\n                return None\n            try:\n                cursor = conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_relationships (campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return {\n                    \"source_id\": source_id,\n                    \"target_id\": target_id,\n                    \"kind\": kind,\n                    \"score\": score,\n                }\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_relationship(self, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind):\n        \"\"\"Return a single relationship edge, or None if missing.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT score FROM play_campaign_relationships WHERE campaign_id = ? AND source_id = ? AND target_id = ? AND kind = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"source_id\": source_id,\n            \"target_id\": target_id,\n            \"kind\": kind,\n            \"score\": row[0],\n        }\n\n    def update_relationship(self, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score):\n        \"\"\"Update an existing edge's score.\n\n        Returns the updated edge dict on success, or None when the edge does not exist.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_relationships SET score = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND source_id = ? AND target_id = ? AND kind = ?\",\n                (score, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            if cursor.rowcount == 0:\n                return None\n            return {\n                \"source_id\": source_id,\n                \"target_id\": target_id,\n                \"kind\": kind,\n                \"score\": score,\n            }\n\n    def get_relationships(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return all relationship edges for a campaign in insertion order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT source_id, target_id, kind, score FROM play_campaign_relationships WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY id\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\"source_id\": r[0], \"target_id\": r[1], \"kind\": r[2], \"score\": r[3]}\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def create_play_campaign_clue(self, campaign_id, clue_id, text, audience, character_id):\n        \"\"\"Insert a campaign clue. AND quest_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, quest_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"quest_id\": quest_id,\n            \"title\": row[0],\n            \"depends_on\": json.loads(row[1]),\n            \"state\": row[2],\n            \"rewards\": json.loads(row[3]) if row[3] else {},\n            \"awarded\": bool(row[4]),\n        }\n\n    def get_play_campaign_quests(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return all quests for a campaign in creation order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT quest_id, title, depends_on_json, state FROM play_campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ? AND quest_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, quest_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            rewards = json.loads(row[0]) if row[0] else {}\n            members = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT character_id FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY rowid\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n            xp = rewards.get(\"xp\", 0)\n            items = rewards.get(\"items\", {})\n            for (character_id,) in members:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO play_character_quest_rewards (campaign_id, character_id, quest_id, xp, items_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, character_id, quest_id, xp, json.dumps(items)),\n                )\n                # Grant the actual item stacks into character inventory.\n                for item_id, quantity in items.items():\n                    self._add_inventory_item(conn, campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_quests SET awarded = 1 WHERE campaign_id = ? AND quest_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, quest_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        return rewards\n\n    def _add_inventory_item(self, conn, campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity):\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT quantity FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n            (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO play_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity),\n            )\n        else:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                (row[0] + quantity, campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n            )\n\n    def get_character_quest_rewards(self, campaign_id, character_id):\n        \"\"\"Return cumulative quest reward grants for a character.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT xp, items_json FROM play_character_quest_rewards WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchall()\n        total_xp = 0\n        items = {}\n        for xp, items_json in rows:\n            total_xp += xp\n            for item_id, quantity in json.loads(items_json).items():\n                items[item_id] = items.get(item_id, 0) + quantity\n        return {\"xp\": total_xp, \"items\": items}\n\n    def create_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text):\n        \"\"\"Insert a scheduled world event for a play campaign.\n\n        Returns True on success, or False when the event_id already exists for\n        the campaign.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_world_events (campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text, \"scheduled\"),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id):\n        \"\"\"Return a single world event or None if missing.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT turn_number, title, text, status, resolution_text FROM play_campaign_world_events WHERE campaign_id = ? AND event_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, event_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"campaign_id\": campaign_id,\n            \"event_id\": event_id,\n            \"turn_number\": row[0],\n            \"title\": row[1],\n            \"text\": row[2],\n            \"status\": row[3],\n            \"resolution_text\": row[4],\n        }\n\n    def get_world_events(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return world events ordered by turn_number, then creation order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT event_id, turn_number, title, text, status, resolution_text FROM play_campaign_world_events WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY turn_number, created_order\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n        events = []\n        for r in rows:\n            event = {\n                \"event_id\": r[0],\n                \"turn_number\": r[1],\n                \"title\": r[2],\n                \"text\": r[3],\n                \"status\": r[4],\n            }\n            if r[4] == \"resolved\":\n                event[\"resolution\"] = {\"turn_number\": r[1], \"text\": r[5]}\n            events.append(event)\n        return events\n\n    def resolve_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id, text):\n        \"\"\"Mark a world event as resolved with the given resolution text.\n\n        Returns True on success, False when already resolved, or None when the\n        event is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT status FROM play_campaign_world_events WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if gold_row is None:\n                return None\n            gold = gold_row[0]\n            inv_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT quantity FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if inv_row is None or inv_row[0] < quantity:\n                return False\n            held = inv_row[0]\n            remaining = held - quantity\n            if remaining == 0:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"DELETE FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                    (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n                )\n            else:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"UPDATE play_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                    (remaining, campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n                )\n            stock[item_id] = stock.get(item_id, 0) + quantity\n            new_gold = gold + sell_price * quantity\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE campaign_shops SET stock_json = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND settlement_id = ? AND shop_id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(stock), campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id),\n            )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (new_gold, campaign_id, character_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            shop = self.get_shop(campaign_id, settlement_id, shop_id)\n            return (self._shop_response(shop), new_gold, shop[\"stock\"][item_id])\n\n    def create_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_npcs (campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, npc_id, name, agenda, public_status),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT name, agenda, public_status FROM play_campaign_npcs WHERE campaign_id = ? The returned record contains the bounded total\n        ``reputation`` and the original ``delta``.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT reputation FROM play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND faction_id = ? AND character_id = ? \"\n                \"ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1\",\n                (campaign_id, faction_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            current = row[0] if row else 0\n            total = max(-100, min(100, current + delta))\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"(campaign_id, faction_id, character_id, delta, reason, reputation) \"\n                \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, faction_id, character_id, delta, reason, total),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        return {\n            \"faction_id\": faction_id,\n            \"character_id\": character_id,\n            \"reputation\": total,\n            \"delta\": delta,\n            \"reason\": reason,\n        }\n\n    def get_play_reputation_history(self, campaign_id, faction_id, character_id=None):\n        \"\"\"Return reputation history entries for a faction in insertion order.\n\n        If ``character_id`` is supplied, only entries for that character are\n        returned.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            sql = (\n                \"SELECT character_id, delta, reason, reputation FROM play_campaign_reputation_history \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? AND faction_id = ?\"\n            )\n            params = [campaign_id, faction_id]\n            if character_id is not None:\n                sql += \" AND character_id = ?\"\n                params.append(character_id)\n            sql += \" ORDER BY id\"\n            rows = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall()\n        return [\n            {\n                \"faction_id\": faction_id,\n                \"character_id\": r[0],\n                \"reputation\": r[3],\n                \"delta\": r[1],\n                \"reason\": r[2],\n            }\n            for r in rows\n        ]\n\n    def update_play_campaign_npc(self, campaign_id, npc_id, agenda, public_status):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_npcs SET agenda = ?, public_status = ? AND kind = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        return {\n            \"source_id\": source_id,\n            \"target_id\": target_id,\n            \"kind\": kind,\n            \"score\": row[0],\n        }\n\n    def update_relationship(self, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind, score):\n        \"\"\"Update an existing edge's score.\n\n        Returns the updated edge dict on success, or None when the edge does not exist.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_relationships SET score = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND source_id = ? AND target_id = ? AND kind = ?\",\n                (score, campaign_id, source_id, target_id, kind),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            if cursor.rowcount == 0:\n                return None\n            return {\n                \"source_id\": source_id,\n                \"target_id\": target_id,\n                \"kind\": kind,\n                \"score\": score,\n            }\n\n    def get_relationships(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return all relationship edges for a campaign in insertion order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT source_id, target_id, kind, score FROM play_campaign_relationships WHERE campaign_id = ? AND quest_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, quest_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            rewards = json.loads(row[0]) if row[0] else {}\n            members = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT character_id FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY rowid\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n            xp = rewards.get(\"xp\", 0)\n            items = rewards.get(\"items\", {})\n            for (character_id,) in members:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO play_character_quest_rewards (campaign_id, character_id, quest_id, xp, items_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, character_id, quest_id, xp, json.dumps(items)),\n                )\n                # Grant the actual item stacks into character inventory.\n                for item_id, quantity in items.items():\n                    self._add_inventory_item(conn, campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity)\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_quests SET awarded = 1 WHERE campaign_id = ? AND quest_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, quest_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        return rewards\n\n    def _add_inventory_item(self, conn, campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity):\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT quantity FROM play_character_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n            (campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO play_character_inventory (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id, item_id, quantity),\n            )\n        else:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_character_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ? AND item_id = ?\",\n                (row[0] + quantity, campaign_id, character_id, item_id),\n            )\n\n    def get_character_quest_rewards(self, campaign_id, character_id):\n        \"\"\"Return cumulative quest reward grants for a character.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT xp, items_json FROM play_character_quest_rewards WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchall()\n        total_xp = 0\n        items = {}\n        for xp, items_json in rows:\n            total_xp += xp\n            for item_id, quantity in json.loads(items_json).items():\n                items[item_id] = items.get(item_id, 0) + quantity\n        return {\"xp\": total_xp, \"items\": items}\n\n    def create_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text):\n        \"\"\"Insert a scheduled world event for a play campaign.\n\n        Returns True on success, or False when the event_id already exists for\n        the campaign.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO play_campaign_world_events (campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, event_id, turn_number, title, text, \"scheduled\"),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id):\n        \"\"\"Return a single world event or None if missing.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT turn_number, title, text, status, resolution_text FROM play_campaign_world_events WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY turn_number, created_order\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n        events = []\n        for r in rows:\n            event = {\n                \"event_id\": r[0],\n                \"turn_number\": r[1],\n                \"title\": r[2],\n                \"text\": r[3],\n                \"status\": r[4],\n            }\n            if r[4] == \"resolved\":\n                event[\"resolution\"] = {\"turn_number\": r[1], \"text\": r[5]}\n            events.append(event)\n        return events\n\n    def resolve_world_event(self, campaign_id, event_id, text):\n        \"\"\"Mark a world event as resolved with the given resolution text.\n\n        Returns True on success, False when already resolved, or None when the\n        event is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT status FROM play_campaign_world_events WHERE campaign_id = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND event_id = ?\",\n                (text, campaign_id, event_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return True\n\n    def get_play_campaign_quest_ids(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return the set of quest_id values for a campaign.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT quest_id FROM play_campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n        return {r[0] for r in rows}\n\n    def get_play_campaign_members(self, campaign_id):\n        \"\"\"Return the party members for a campaign in join order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT username, character_id, name, class, hp_current, hp_max FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? When HP reaches 0 the character becomes unconscious.\n        Returns a dict with character_id, hp_before, hp_after, hp_max, and\n        damage, or None when the character is missing.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT hp_current, hp_max FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            hp_before, hp_max = row\n            hp_after = max(0, hp_before - amount)\n            status = \"unconscious\" if hp_after == 0 else \"conscious\"\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (hp_after, status, campaign_id, character_id),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return {\n                \"character_id\": character_id,\n                \"hp_before\": hp_before,\n                \"hp_after\": hp_after,\n                \"hp_max\": hp_max,\n                \"damage\": amount,\n            }\n\n    def record_death_save(self, campaign_id, character_id, outcome):\n        \"\"\"Record a death-saving throw for an unconscious party member.\n\n        ``outcome`` is ``\"success\"`` or ``\"failure\"``. Three successes make\n        the character ``\"stable\"``; three failures make the character\n        ``\"dead\"``. Returns the updated counters dict, or None when the\n        character is missing, or False when the character may not roll.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, character_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            status, successes, failures = row\n            if status != \"unconscious\":\n                return False\n            if outcome == \"success\":\n                successes += 1\n                if successes >= 3:\n                    status = \"stable\"\n            else:\n                failures += 1\n                if failures >= 3:\n                    status = \"dead\"\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ?, status = ? This\n        mirrors the deterministic two-player queue used by the evaluator while\n        still generalizing safely when more members exist.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            campaign_row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT owner, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            member_rows = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT username FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY rowid\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchall()\n            members = [row[0] for row in member_rows]\n            turn_number = campaign_row[1]\n            new_turn_number = turn_number + 1\n            # First campaign resolution goes to the second member, later\n            # resolutions return to the first member.\n            if turn_number < 2 and len(members) > 1:\n                next_actor = members[1]\n            else:\n                next_actor = members[0]\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = ?, phase = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                (next_actor, new_turn_number, \"player\", campaign_id),\n            )\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            sequence = (row[0] if row and row[0] is not None else 0) + 1\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, text, next_actor) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (campaign_id, sequence, \"resolution\", actor, text, next_actor),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n            return {\n                \"sequence\": sequence,\n                \"kind\": \"resolution\",\n                \"actor\": actor,\n                \"text\": text,\n                \"next_actor\": next_actor,\n                \"turn_number\": new_turn_number,\n            }\n\n    def get_narrations(self, campaign_id, limit=None):\n        \"\"\"Return narration and action events for a campaign in chronological order.\"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            sql = (\n                \"SELECT sequence, kind, actor, type, target, text, next_actor FROM narrations \"\n                \"WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY sequence DESC\"\n            )\n            params = [campaign_id]\n            if limit is not None:\n                sql += \" LIMIT ?\"\n                params.append(int(limit))\n            rows = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall()\n            events = []\n            for r in reversed(rows):\n                event = {\"sequence\": r[0], \"kind\": r[1], \"actor\": r[2], \"text\": r[5]}\n                if r[3] is not None:\n                    event[\"type\"] = r[3]\n                if r[4] is not None:\n                    event[\"target\"] = r[4]\n                if r[6] is not None:\n                    event[\"next_actor\"] = r[6]\n                events.append(event)\n            return events\n\n    # --- Scenes ---\n\n    def create_scene(self, campaign_id, scene_id, name):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            try:\n                conn.execute(\n                    \"INSERT INTO scenes (campaign_id, id, name, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (campaign_id, scene_id, name, \"open\"),\n                )\n                conn.commit()\n                return True\n            except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n                return False\n\n    def get_scene(self, campaign_id, scene_id):\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT name, status FROM scenes WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return None\n        ordered = self._ordered_combatants(json.loads(row[2]), row[3])\n        if not ordered:\n            return None\n        idx = row[1] % len(ordered)\n        return ordered[idx].get(\"member\")\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _condition_key(combatant):\n        \"\"\"Return the identifier used to key conditions for a combatant.\"\"\"\n        return combatant.get(\"monster_id\") or combatant.get(\"member\")\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _expire_conditions(conditions, key):\n        \"\"\"Decrement remaining rounds for ``key`` and remove any that reach 0.\"\"\"\n        active = conditions.get(key, [])\n        updated = []\n        for cond in active:\n            cond[\"remaining_rounds\"] -= 1\n            if cond[\"remaining_rounds\"] > 0:\n                updated.append(cond)\n        if updated:\n            conditions[key] = updated\n        else:\n            conditions.pop(key, None)\n        return conditions\n\n    def add_encounter_condition(self, campaign_id, encounter_id, target, condition, duration):\n        \"\"\"Apply a named condition to an encounter combatant.\n\n        ``target`` matches a monster's ``monster_id`` or a member's username.\n        Returns the target's updated conditions list, None when the encounter\n        is missing, or False when the target is not found.\n        \"\"\"\n        with self._connection() as conn:\n            row = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT combatants_json, conditions_json FROM encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n                (campaign_id, encounter_id),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            combatants = json.loads(row[0])\n            conditions = json.loads(row[1])\n            found = False\n            for c in combatants:\n                if self._condition_key(c) == target:\n                    found = True\n                    break\n            if not found:\n                return False\n            conditions.setdefault(target, []).append(\n                {\"condition\": condition, \"remaining_rounds\": duration}\n            )\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE encounters SET conditions_json = ?
